observations.method: Original layer-aware contour association, independent retained-top/floor probes, full incoming-height through rays.

P1.probe_selection: 25 deterministic spread positions on original retained top, excluding the pocket and holes with a two-cell guard; no result-driven selection.

floor.probe_selection: 25 deterministic original retained-floor probes, excluding declared holes plus two cells; no result-driven selection.

observations.section_request_policy: Original-CAD layer boundaries determine stable interior slices before reading the mesh; no geometry rounding or result-driven registration.

limitations: One facing operation, 2 to 8 disjoint rounded closed pockets at individual floor heights, optionally disjoint holes wholly inside one floor or on the top land; explicit card order. Qualification cases establish only their tested combinations.
Hole-wall sections follow original layer heights; through rays span the whole incoming stock. Retained-top and floor probes exclude only original declared openings.
11 contours per feature, 25 probes per retained plane and 9 rays per hole are finite observations, not continuous GD&T.
Final geometry alone does not establish order / tools; separate NC and cumulative material checks are required.
Two cells are a numerical guard, not certified uncertainty; no nonzero WCS/TLO, roughness, fixtures, holder or material physics.
